a9b4ed1ce5.q: What is the appropriate marketing mix between brand and performance marketing according to recent studies?
a9b4ed1ce5.a: According to research by Bain & Company called 'The Long and Short of It', the appropriate mix is approximately 62% brand marketing and 38% performance or call-to-action marketing. Many businesses, especially marketers, focus 100% on call-to-action performance marketing and forget about building brand awareness, which allows the company to rent-free live in potential customers' minds so when they need the service, they think of you first.

8f3d92d15f.q: What conference booth strategy did Rival Digital use instead of traditional lead-capture tactics?
8f3d92d15f.a: Instead of standard booth tactics like tablecloths, pens, candy, and product demos, Rival Digital gave out items hungover conference attendees actually needed like Red Bull, Zen, Tylenol, water, and Liquid IV. They geofenced the Louisville Expo Hall and Expo Center with an ad saying 'hang over here with us after the bourbon distillery tour' with no pushy call-to-action, allowing attendees to remember them as the helpful brand rather than aggressive salespeople.

0edc859311.q: What service lines did Rival Digital expand from HVAC to include in home services?
0edc859311.a: Rival Digital expanded from HVAC-only to include plumbing, electrical, and garage door companies. Eric Thomas explained that many HVAC companies already install water heaters without needing plumbing licenses since they work gas lines similar to furnaces and condensers. Water heaters became a gateway to plumbing services because homeowners would then ask them to fix toilets and faucets. Larger companies they targeted already offered multiple service lines with bigger marketing budgets.
